en: A black and white image of a large, imposing stone building with a symmetrical facade, arched windows, and a central arched entrance. The building is three stories high with additional attic windows. Above the entrance, there is a sign bearing the words 'SZENT MÓR KOLLÉGIUM.' The foreground shows a rough, open area, suggesting the building is relatively new or on the outskirts of development. At the bottom of the image, handwritten text reads 'Pécs. Sz. Mór Kollegium.'
